names.house_1708_prairie: 1708 Prairie Avenue — three-storey brick front with a canted bay (Thorne-associated)

source.citation: [1706 and 1700 S. Prairie Avenue, the townhouses of George Glessner and Frances Glessner Lee.] Photograph from the east side of Prairie Avenue, captioned 'Left: 1706 S. Prairie Avenue / Right: 1700 S. Prairie Avenue'; photographer and original holder not named. Reproduced by Chicagology, '1706 Prairie Avenue' (chicagology.com/chicagostreets/prairieavenue/1706prairie/).
what_it_does_not_supply: the rest of 1708's front, its cornice and its bay, all outside the frame
the south wall, the rear and the roof
what_it_supplies: the north end of 1708's street front in the plane of the townhouses' front
the upper storeys' sill heights at the north end, a cross-check on the Christmas print
the entrance hood at the north end and its height
